title: ctenitis abyssi
intro: Ctenitis abyssi, commonly known as the Abyssal fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine, particularly for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. Ctenitis abyssi is reported to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it a promising candidate for the treatment of various diseases. The bioactive constituents of Ctenitis abyssi include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
